nodes.title: lPrompt
widgets_values:
段1:0-3秒
Live-action, cinematic, a medium-wide shot frames a young woman in a dark trench coat and short hair, holding a black umbrella, walking briskly along a rain-soaked city sidewalk at night. The camera is static. Steady rain taps on the umbrella, and her footsteps splash through shallow puddles. Her low breathing mixes with the rain. Non‑diegetic music: sparse piano notes at a very slow tempo begin.

段2:3-6秒
The camera cuts to a medium shot as she slows and stops beneath a dim yellow streetlamp. She tilts her head up to gaze at the glowing bulb; her breath forms white mist in the cold air. Rain softens under the lamp, and a distant traffic hum continues. The piano music continues with a single low cello drone joining softly.

段3:6-9秒
The shot cuts to a close-up of her hands pulling a smartphone from her coat pocket. She glances down at the screen, brow furrowing. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward the phone. The click of the phone case and a notification chime are heard. The piano and cello sustain a melancholic tone.

段4:9-12秒
The camera cuts to a medium shot as she pockets the phone, looks left and right along the empty street, then grips her coat collar with both hands, tightening it against the wind. A gust whistles and fabric rustles. The background music slowly adds a soft, sustained string harmony.

段5:12-15秒
The shot cuts to a wide shot as she resumes walking, now almost jogging across the street. The camera trucks left with medium amplitude at normal speed, following her. Water sprays from her heels, and rain intensifies, drumming heavily. The piano notes become slightly more frequent, matching her quickened pace.

段6:15-18秒
The camera cuts to a medium shot as she reaches a covered awning in front of a closed shop. She stops, folds her umbrella briskly, and shakes off water. The metallic snap of the closing umbrella and water splattering on pavement are audible. The music maintains its slow tempo but the cello gently swells.

段7:18-21秒
The shot cuts to a medium close-up as she leans back against the wall, slightly out of breath. She turns her head to gaze down the street, focusing on approaching headlights through the rain. A distant car engine grows louder; her breathing steadies. The piano and cello fade slightly to allow the engine sound to dominate.

段8:21-24秒
The camera cuts to a low-angle shot as the headlights approach and a yellow taxi pulls up to the curb. Tires splash through a puddle, and the engine idles with a low rumble. The rear window rolls down, revealing the driver's silhouette. The music recedes to a near‑silent hum.

段9:24-27秒
The shot cuts to a side view as she steps forward, opens the rear door, and bends to speak to the driver. The door handle clicks. The woman (S1) says in a slightly tired voice: <d>[中文] 师傅，去市中心，谢谢。</d> The driver (S2) replies muffled: <d>[中文] 好嘞，上车吧。</d> The music fades completely during the dialogue, leaving only rain and engine sounds.

段10:27-30秒
The camera cuts to a wide shot as she folds her umbrella, slides into the back seat, and pulls the door shut with a solid thud. The heavy thump of the door and rain pattering against the car roof are heard. The background music quietly resumes with a single sustained cello note.

段11:30-33秒
The shot cuts to an interior medium shot inside the taxi. She settles into the seat, fastens her seatbelt, and leans her head against the window. The engine revs and the taxi pulls away; windshield wipers squeak rhythmically. The piano returns with sparse, slow notes, now slightly warmer in tone.

段12:33-36秒
The camera cuts to a close-up of her face reflected in the side window. She stares blankly at the rain‑streaked glass, her expression softening. Tire hum on wet asphalt and distant passing cars fill the soundscape. The cello drones softly beneath the piano, creating a calm atmosphere.

段13:36-39秒
The shot cuts to an exterior tracking shot as the taxi moves through city streets. The camera tracks alongside with large amplitude at normal speed, showing wet pavement and sliding streetlights. Rain continues steadily; engine note is consistent. The music gradually increases in volume, adding a gentle string layer.

段14:39-42秒
The camera cuts to a front view inside the taxi, looking at the rearview mirror. The driver (S2) adjusts the mirror, and the woman (S1) asks quietly: <d>[中文] 大概多久能到？</d> The driver (S2) responds: <d>[中文] 不堵车的话，二十分钟。</d> Their voices are clear over cabin noise. The music holds a soft, expectant chord.

段15:42-45秒
The shot cuts to a final wide aerial view as the taxi turns a corner onto a brighter, busier avenue. The camera zooms out slowly with large amplitude at slow speed, revealing the city skyline glistening under rain. Rain and traffic sounds gradually fade as the taxi disappears. The piano and cello play a final, gentle arpeggio, then fade to silence.
